components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Multi-select filter for an Occupation Domain, Region or lane group; the swatch carries the lane colour.
components.css: .ds-pill{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-bg-surface-raised, #fff);border:1px solid var(--color-border-control, #837757);font:inherit;font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--color-text-primary, #241a10);cursor:pointer;transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-pill:hover{border-color:var(--color-text-secondary, #6b6046);background:var(--color-bg-surface, #fbf6e9)}.ds-pill:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #6e2013); outline-offset: 1px;}.ds-pill-active{border-color:var(--color-accent-selected, #8a2a1a);background:var(--color-bg-surface, #fbf6e9);font-weight:600;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-accent-selected, #8a2a1a)}.ds-pill-active:hover{border-color:var(--color-accent-selected, #8a2a1a)}.ds-swatch{flex:0 0 auto;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:9999px}

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Pill-shaped search field with a ledger-paper hover; matches show in oxblood.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="text" placeholder="Search people, conflicts, milestones" />
components.css: .ds-search{box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-bg-surface-raised, #fff);border:1px solid var(--color-border-control, #837757);font:inherit;font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--color-text-primary, #241a10);transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-search::placeholder{color:var(--color-text-secondary, #6b6046)}.ds-search:hover{border-color:var(--color-text-secondary, #6b6046);background:var(--color-bg-surface, #fbf6e9)}.ds-search:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #6e2013); outline-offset: 1px;}

components.name: Detail Level Switch
components.description: The current Detail Level and four progress pips in a pill that opens the level list.
components.html:
Detail LevelMainstream▾
  • LegendaryThe most famous entries
  • MainstreamWidely known entries
  • SpecializedLess widely known entries
  • Deep CutThe most detailed view
components.css: .ds-switch{position:relative;width:280px;max-width:100%;font:12px/1.4 Archivo,sans-serif;color:var(--color-text-primary,#241a10)} .ds-trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;list-style:none;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--color-border-control,#837757);border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-bg-surface-raised,#fff);transition:border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1),background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)} .ds-trigger::-webkit-details-marker{display:none} .ds-trigger:hover{border-color:var(--color-text-secondary,#6b6046);background:var(--color-bg-surface,#fbf6e9)} .ds-trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-focus-ring,#6e2013);outline-offset:1px} .ds-switch[open] .ds-trigger{border-color:var(--color-accent-selected,#8a2a1a);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-accent-selected,#8a2a1a);background:var(--color-bg-surface,#fbf6e9)} .ds-prefix,.ds-description{color:var(--color-text-secondary,#6b6046);font-size:11px} .ds-value{flex:1;min-width:0;font-weight:600;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap} .ds-chevron{color:var(--color-text-secondary,#6b6046);font-size:10px} .ds-switch[open] .ds-chevron{transform:rotate(180deg)} .ds-pips{display:inline-flex;gap:3px} .ds-pip{width:10px;height:4px;border-radius:9999px;background:var(--color-border-subtle,#e0d3ac)} .ds-pip.ds-reached{background:var(--color-accent-selected,#8a2a1a)} .ds-levels{display:grid;gap:2px;margin:6px 0 0;padding:4px;list-style:none;border:1px solid var(--color-border-subtle,#e0d3ac);border-radius:12px;background:var(--color-bg-surface-raised,#fff);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15)} .ds-level{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-content:center;align-items:center;gap:2px 12px;min-height:44px;padding:0 10px;border-radius:6px} .ds-level .ds-pips{grid-area:1 / 2 / span 2 / 3} .ds-level[aria-current]{background:var(--color-bg-surface,#fbf6e9);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--color-accent-selected,#8a2a1a)} .ds-level[aria-current]>span:first-child{font-weight:600} @media(max-width:420px){.ds-trigger .ds-pips{display:none}}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single oxblood call to action, such as the Wikipedia link in the detail panel.

components.name: Zoom Controls
components.description: Joined vertical group of 28px glyph buttons with a Control Border outline.
components.css: .ds-zoom{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;border:1px solid var(--color-border-control, #837757);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.ds-zoom button{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;border:none;border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-border-control, #837757);background:var(--color-bg-surface-raised, #fff);color:var(--color-text-primary, #241a10);font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}.ds-zoom button:last-child{border-bottom:none}.ds-zoom button:hover{background:var(--color-bg-surface, #fbf6e9)}.ds-zoom button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-focus-ring, #6e2013);outline-offset:-2px}

narrative.overview: “The Scribe’s Chronicle” uses the Ledger & Ink palette of parchment, iron-gall text and oxblood for interactive state. Keep the controls compact and the marks prominent. Labels use short, sentence-case nouns. The site uses a single light theme.
